11.title: Audio Lesson: let the learner control playback
11.description: Add an audio player for a lesson recording. The learner must be able to start, pause, and adjust playback; the page must not autoplay the recording.
11.learningObjective: Provide native audio controls and avoid starting sound automatically.
instructions: Create an audio element with `controls`.
Add a source for `/media/lesson-intro.mp3` with type `audio/mpeg`.
Include fallback text inside the audio element.
Do not add autoplay.

workedExample.output: An audio element with controls and no autoplay attribute.
workedExample.explanation: Native controls give users a familiar way to operate media. Avoiding autoplay prevents unexpected sound and respects user control.

11.hint: The boolean `controls` attribute exposes the browser’s playback controls; the autoplay attribute would start playback without a user action.
11.explanation: Native controls give users a familiar way to operate media. Avoiding autoplay prevents unexpected sound and respects user control.

testCases.description: Provide a source and MIME type.

11.expectedOutput: Lesson introduction
11.expectedOutputHint: Visual reference only. HTML completion is reviewed against source requirements, not browser-executed tests.
11.starterCode: Lesson introduction

12.title: Video Captions: attach a captions track
12.description: A short course video has an English WebVTT captions file at `/media/lesson-en.vtt`. Add a captions track and keep the video under learner control.
12.learningObjective: Attach a captions track to a video so spoken content can be followed without audio.
instructions: Create a video element with `controls` and a useful width.
Add a track with `kind="captions"`.
Set the track source to `/media/lesson-en.vtt`, language to `en`, and label to `English`.
Mark the English track as the default.

workedExample.input: A lesson video with English captions
workedExample.output: A controlled video element with a default English captions track.
workedExample.explanation: Captions provide access to dialogue and meaningful sound information. A label and language identify the track to users and media controls.

12.hint: Captions include spoken dialogue and relevant sounds; the track element references a WebVTT file.
12.explanation: Captions provide access to dialogue and meaningful sound information. A label and language identify the track to users and media controls.

testCases.description: Use a captions track rather than subtitles for same-language dialogue.
Mark the provided track as default.

12.expectedOutput: Course video
12.expectedOutputHint: Visual reference only. HTML completion is reviewed against source requirements, not browser-executed tests.
12.starterCode: Course video

16.title: Canvas Summary: keep an equivalent text description
16.description: A canvas shows a simple bar chart of three course scores. Add fallback content that states the same values in text so the information is not available only as pixels.
16.learningObjective: Supply readable fallback content when a canvas drawing cannot be perceived or rendered.
instructions: Create a canvas with a clear id and dimensions.
Add fallback text inside the canvas element.

workedExample.output: A canvas with a text summary listing each course score.
workedExample.explanation: Canvas pixels do not automatically expose chart values as accessible text. A text equivalent makes the data available even when the drawing cannot be interpreted.
